intro: Small, sleek, and surprisingly spacious. The Milee corner table keeps cables in check while giving your room a lift in style and utility.

features.title: Slide, store, smile
features.text: Clever slidable panels open up hidden compartments for chargers, accessories, or cable dumps—making tidiness effortless and hidden clutter disappear.

features.title: Gloss that lasts
features.text: With a high-gloss, scratch-resistant finish, this compact table stays pristine and stylish, even with daily use—adding durable elegance to your corners.

features.title: Sized just right
features.text: Its compact footprint fits perfectly in tight spaces, offering both style and function without overwhelming your layout—perfect beside your sofa.

features.title: Room to display
features.text: A lower open shelf gives you space to show off small décor, candles, or books—adding personality and practicality to even the smallest corner.

features.title: Stylishly elevated
features.text: Raised off the ground with a sleek profile, this design brings an airy, modern vibe while making cleaning and rearranging easier than ever.

specs: Size (W x H x D, cm)
care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
name: Milee Enginnered Wood Corner Table With Cable Management
